user_account_tombstone_check.name: user_account_tombstone_check
user_account_tombstone_check.value: ("user"."account_status" = 'live' and "user"."deleted_at" is null and "user"."deleted_email" is null) or ("user"."account_status" in ('deleted', 'anonymized') and "user"."deleted_at" is not null and "user"."email" = 'deleted+' || "user"."id" || '@deleted.agentcore.local' and ("user"."account_status" <> 'anonymized' or "user"."deleted_email" is null))

auto_topup_attempt_intent_state_check.name: auto_topup_attempt_intent_state_check
auto_topup_attempt_intent_state_check.value: ("auto_topup_attempt"."status" not in ('pending', 'succeeded') or "auto_topup_attempt"."stripe_payment_intent_id" is not null) and ("auto_topup_attempt"."status" <> 'superseded' or "auto_topup_attempt"."stripe_payment_intent_id" is null)

auto_topup_attempt_card_state_check.name: auto_topup_attempt_card_state_check
auto_topup_attempt_card_state_check.value: ("auto_topup_attempt"."status" <> 'creating' or "auto_topup_attempt"."payment_method_id" is null) and ("auto_topup_attempt"."status" <> 'charging' or "auto_topup_attempt"."payment_method_id" is not null)

credit_grant_consumed_range_check.name: credit_grant_consumed_range_check
credit_grant_consumed_range_check.value: "credit_grant"."consumed" >= 0 and (("credit_grant"."source" = 'debt' and "credit_grant"."consumed" between "credit_grant"."amount" and 2 * "credit_grant"."amount") or ("credit_grant"."source" <> 'debt' and "credit_grant"."consumed" <= "credit_grant"."amount"))

credit_grant_debt_kind_check.name: credit_grant_debt_kind_check
credit_grant_debt_kind_check.value: ("credit_grant"."source" = 'debt') = ("credit_grant"."debt_kind" is not null) and ("credit_grant"."debt_kind" is null or "credit_grant"."debt_kind" in ('usage', 'hold', 'refund', 'restored'))

credit_grant_hold_parent_check.name: credit_grant_hold_parent_check
credit_grant_hold_parent_check.value: "credit_grant"."debt_kind" is distinct from 'hold' or "credit_grant"."parent_grant_id" is not null

custom_tool_dispatch_delivery_check.name: custom_tool_dispatch_delivery_check
custom_tool_dispatch_delivery_check.value: ("custom_tool_dispatch"."status" in ('awaiting_decision', 'claimed', 'executing') and "custom_tool_dispatch"."delivery" is null) or ("custom_tool_dispatch"."status" in ('ready', 'delivering', 'delivered') and "custom_tool_dispatch"."delivery" is not null) or "custom_tool_dispatch"."status" in ('completed', 'abandoned')

message_feedback_message_shape_check.name: message_feedback_message_shape_check
message_feedback_message_shape_check.value: "message_feedback"."kind" <> 'message' or ("message_feedback"."session_id" is not null and "message_feedback"."anthropic_event_id" is not null and "message_feedback"."rating" is not null)

message_feedback_app_shape_check.name: message_feedback_app_shape_check
message_feedback_app_shape_check.value: "message_feedback"."kind" <> 'app' or ("message_feedback"."body" is not null and "message_feedback"."route" is not null)

pending_confirmation_decision_check.name: pending_confirmation_decision_check
pending_confirmation_decision_check.value: ("pending_confirmation"."status" = 'pending' and "pending_confirmation"."decided_at" is null) or ("pending_confirmation"."status" in ('approved', 'denied') and "pending_confirmation"."decided_at" is not null)

session_pause_consistency_check.name: session_pause_consistency_check
session_pause_consistency_check.value: ("session"."status" in ('pausing', 'paused_no_credits', 'resuming') and "session"."paused_at" is not null and "session"."paused_reason" is not null) or ("session"."status" not in ('pausing', 'paused_no_credits', 'resuming') and "session"."paused_at" is null and "session"."paused_reason" is null)

session_archive_check.name: session_archive_check
session_archive_check.value: "session"."provider_archived_at" is null or "session"."hidden_at" is not null

session_browser_lease_check.name: session_browser_lease_check
session_browser_lease_check.value: ("session"."browserbase_session_status" is not null and "session"."browserbase_session_status" in ('user', 'acting', 'closing')) = ("session"."browser_lease_expires_at" is not null)

session_browser_end_check.name: session_browser_end_check
session_browser_end_check.value: ("session"."browserbase_session_status" is not null and "session"."browserbase_session_status" in ('closed', 'ended')) = ("session"."browserbase_session_ended_at" is not null)

session_browser_identity_check.name: session_browser_identity_check
session_browser_identity_check.value: ("session"."browserbase_session_status" is null and "session"."browserbase_session_id" is null) or ("session"."browserbase_session_status" is not null and "session"."browserbase_session_id" is not null and "session"."browserbase_session_started_at" is not null)

session_send_attempt_check.name: session_send_attempt_check
session_send_attempt_check.value: ("session_send"."status" in ('sending', 'unconfirmed')) = ("session_send"."attempt_token" is not null and "session_send"."recover_after" is not null)

skill_anthropic_skill_id_uidx.name: skill_anthropic_skill_id_uidx
skill_anthropic_skill_id_uidx.where: "skill"."anthropic_skill_id" is not null and "skill"."owner_workspace_id" is null

skill_publication_check.name: skill_publication_check
skill_publication_check.value: ("skill"."status" = 'publishing' and "skill"."publication" is not null) or ("skill"."status" = 'ready' and "skill"."publication" is null) or "skill"."status" = 'deleting'

skill_owner_kind_check.name: skill_owner_kind_check
skill_owner_kind_check.value: ("skill"."kind" in ('anthropic', 'preset') and "skill"."owner_workspace_id" is null) or ("skill"."kind" = 'custom' and "skill"."owner_workspace_id" is not null)

task_schedule_definition_check.name: task_schedule_definition_check
task_schedule_definition_check.value: "task"."trigger_type" <> 'schedule' or ("task"."cron_schedule" is not null and "task"."run_at" is null) or ("task"."cron_schedule" is null and "task"."run_at" is not null)

usage_event_platform_paid_check.name: usage_event_platform_paid_check
usage_event_platform_paid_check.value: not "usage_event"."platform_paid" or ("usage_event"."credits_delta" = 0 and "usage_event"."vendor_cost_cents" is not null)

workspace_budget_sync_lease_check.name: workspace_budget_sync_lease_check
workspace_budget_sync_lease_check.value: ("workspace"."budget_sync_status" = 'syncing' and "workspace"."budget_sync_lease" is not null and "workspace"."budget_sync_lease_until" is not null) or ("workspace"."budget_sync_status" <> 'syncing' and "workspace"."budget_sync_lease" is null and "workspace"."budget_sync_lease_until" is null)

workspace_plan_entitlement_check.name: workspace_plan_entitlement_check
workspace_plan_entitlement_check.value: ("workspace"."plan_tier" = 'none' and "workspace"."stripe_subscription_id" is null and "workspace"."plan_credits" is null) or ("workspace"."plan_tier" in ('pro', 'max') and "workspace"."stripe_subscription_id" is not null and "workspace"."plan_billing_interval" is not null and "workspace"."plan_credits" is not null and "workspace"."plan_credits" > 0)

workspace_plan_billing_interval_check.name: workspace_plan_billing_interval_check
workspace_plan_billing_interval_check.value: ("workspace"."plan_tier" = 'none' and "workspace"."plan_billing_interval" is null) or ("workspace"."plan_tier" in ('pro', 'max') and "workspace"."plan_billing_interval" in ('month', 'year'))

workspace_member_vault_state_check.name: workspace_member_vault_state_check
workspace_member_vault_state_check.value: ("workspace_member"."vault_status" = 'unprovisioned' and "workspace_member"."vault_claimed_at" is null) or ("workspace_member"."vault_status" = 'provisioning' and "workspace_member"."vault_claimed_at" is not null) or ("workspace_member"."vault_status" = 'provisioned' and "workspace_member"."mcp_proxy_vault_id" is not null and "workspace_member"."vault_credential_updated_at" is not null and "workspace_member"."vault_claimed_at" is null)
